title: Pure Amorphage
summary: Amorphage is an EARTH Dragon Pendulum stun archetype where every monster locks both players out of the Extra Deck and applies a unique Continuous floodgate in the Pendulum Zone. Amorphage Infection and Amorphactor Pain maintain tribute fodder and lock the opponent out of their Main Phase 1.

allow.Amorphactor Pain, the Imagination Dracov: Honorary boss monster summoned via Amorphous Persona that skips the opponent's Main Phase 1 and negates Extra Deck monster effects.
allow.Odd-Eyes Revolution Dragon: Searches any Level 8 or lower Dragon Pendulum monster by discarding itself and paying 500 LP.

main: Amorphage Goliath
Scale 5 Level 8 boss that banishes any card sent to the GY while in the Pendulum Zone.
Amorphage Sloth
Scale 3 Level 6 monster that prevents both players from adding cards from the Deck to the hand except by drawing.
Amorphage Pride
Scale 3 Level 4 monster that prevents both players from taking effect damage and serves as a Normal Summonable lock.
Amorphage Wrath
Scale 3 Level 4 monster that prevents both players from Tributing monsters, except Amorphage monsters.
Amorphage Envy
Scale 5 Level 4 monster that prevents both players from activating cards or effects as Chain Link 2 or higher.
Amorphage Greed
Scale 3 Level 4 monster that prevents both players from activating Trap Cards and their effects.
Amorphage Lechery
Scale 5 Level 2 monster that prevents both players from activating Spell Cards and their effects, except Amorphage Spells.
Amorphage Gluttony
Scale 5 Level 2 monster that prevents monsters from activating their effects, except Amorphage monsters.
Amorphactor Pain, the Imagination Dracoverlord
Ritual boss summoned by Amorphous Persona that skips the opponent's Main Phase 1.
Odd-Eyes Revolution Dragon
Consistency booster that searches Sloth, Goliath, or any Scale 3/5 Amorphage Dragon.
Amorphage Infection
Continuous Spell that boosts ATK/DEF and searches any Amorphage card when a monster is Tributed or destroyed.
Amorphous Persona
Field Spell that boosts Amorphage stats, draws up to 2 cards per turn on Tribute, and Ritual Summons Amorphactor Pain.
Amorphage Lysis
Continuous Trap that weakens non-Amorphage monsters and immediately replaces destroyed Pendulum Scales from the Deck.
